# Upstream Buzz compile-error allowlist.
#
# One base filename per line, sorted, naming files under upstream
# <buzz-checkout>/tests/compile_errors/*.buzz that gopherbuzz correctly REJECTS
# (see ../conformance_test.go). Upstream requires each of these to fail to
# compile; a file NOT listed here is one gopherbuzz still wrongly accepts, which
# is a soundness gap rather than a missing feature.
#
# The set may only GROW. TestUpstreamCompileErrors fails if a listed file starts
# compiling clean (gopherbuzz got laxer) or if an unlisted file starts failing
# (progress that must be recorded here).
bad-fun-signature.buzz
bad-pattern.buzz
break.buzz
const.buzz
duplicated-namespace.buzz
early-return.buzz
early-throw.buzz
empty-import.buzz
final-objects.buzz
inferred-enum-case-invalid.buzz
invalid-float-literal.buzz
invalid-int-literal.buzz
label-not-found.buzz
labeled-continue-terminal-flow.buzz
local-assignment-value-type.buzz
long-tuple.buzz
match-duplicate-condition-folded.buzz
match-duplicate-condition-number.buzz
match-duplicate-condition-same-branch.buzz
match-else-missing-arrow.buzz
match-enum-non-exhaustive.buzz
match-non-exhaustive.buzz
match-number-condition-type.buzz
match-overlapping-folded-range.buzz
match-overlapping-range.buzz
match-range-containing-literal.buzz
match-string-condition-type.buzz
match-value-condition-type.buzz
misplaced-out.buzz
missing-return-one-branch.buzz
multiple-location.buzz
object-assignment-value-type.buzz
terminal-break-unreachable.buzz
terminal-continue-unreachable.buzz
terminal-if-unreachable.buzz
terminal-loop-unreachable.buzz
tuple-mix.buzz
tuple-shorthand-anonymous-numeric-field.buzz
tuple-shorthand-binary-index.buzz
tuple-shorthand-hex-index.buzz
tuple-shorthand-named-object.buzz
tuple-shorthand-out-of-range.buzz
tuple-shorthand-underscore-index.buzz
var-decl-without-value.buzz
yield-wrong-value-type.buzz
